name: mcp
title: Suite A — MCP agent flow
description: A real kagisecure-mcp sidecar, spoken to as an MCP client over stdio, against a real kagisecure daemon over a real unix socket. Three processes, no mocks below the human.
note: The daemon is the headless host. The app-hosted listener is the same kagisecure-agent library behind a SwiftUI approval sheet and a biometric gate; phase 2 drives it through XCUITest. See docs/e2e-harness.md §5.
